frequencyTiers.comment: Grammalecte 'Indice de fréquence' (0-9) of the most frequent spelling, mapped to 4 tiers (0 rare … 3 very common) used by the AI vocabulary profiles. Corpus counts of very short strings are inflated by abbreviations and noise, so short words lose a few points first.
